In the medial compartment, there is horizontal tear with intrameniscal cyst (about intact4*intact6 cm) at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. There is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. 
 The lateral compartment, the meniscus is not torn and there is no focal chondrosis or chondral injury. There is subchondral bone bruise at the posterolateral tibial plateau.  
 The patellofemoral joint, the patellar and trochlear cartilage appears congruent without chondral lesion. The medial patellofemoral ligament is intact.  
 In the intercondylar notch, there is complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. The posterior cruciate ligaments are intact. There is no tibial translation. 
 There is grade I ligamentous sprain of the medial collateral ligament, at mid substance. The posteromedial oblique ligament is intact.  
 There is grade I ligamentous sprain of the lateral collateral ligament. The popliteofibular ligament is intact. The meniscopopliteal fascicles are intact.  
 The extensor mechanism is normal.  
 Some knee effusion is present. The surrounding musculature is normal. There is no fracture or bone contusion.  Horizontal tear with intrameniscal cyst (about intact4*intact6 cm) at the posterior horn of the medial meniscus. 
  Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament, at mid substance. 
  Grade I ligamentous sprain of the medial collateral ligament, at mid substance.  
  Grade I ligamentous sprain of the lateral collateral ligament.  
  Some knee effusion.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Innnenmeniskus. Verletzung des medialen Kapselbandapparates mit Partialruptur des MCL (Serie 8/ Image 17, Serie 4/ Image 19).

Laterales Kompartiment:
Geringes Kontusionsödem am posterolateralen Tibiaplateau. Ansonsten regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Außenmeniskus. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Patella:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Fokaler bis zur Grenzlamelle reichender Knorpeldefekt am Patellafirst (Outerbridge Grad 3) (Serie 8/ Image 9). Regelrechte Darstellung des Lig. patellae. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Gelenkerguss. Regelrechtes flow void in den miterfassten Gefäßen.

[DATE]: MR Knie Rechts 15ch AA: Klinische inlichtingen: plots door de knie gezakt, hevige pijn, echografisch vermoedelijk mediale meniscus scheur Diagnostische vraagstelling: meniscusscheur? Bevindingen: Beginnend lateraal femorotibiaal kraakbeenlijden graad 2 met enkele oppervlakkige fissuren. Normaal voorkomen menisci. Kruisbanden laterale banden intact. Normaal voorkomen verschillende pezen. Matige opzetting van suprapatellaire recessus met inliggende verdikte synoviale plooien. Os fabella: anatomische variant, niet verwikkeld. Lokaal gevorderd femoropatellair kraakbeenlijden graad 4 met enkele diepe fissuren op de crista patellaris, gepaard gaand met subchondrale geode op de junctie van het bovenste en onderste 3e van de crista patellaris. Kleine Bakerse cyste . Besluit: Lokaal gevorderd femoropatellaire kraakbeenlijden graad 4 essentieel op de crista patellaris, op heden met minimale hydrops en chronische synovitis. Geen evidentie voor meniscusscheur.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Außenmeniskus. Intaktes MCL.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Oberflächliche Irregularitäten des Knorpel am lateralen Tibiaplateau. Kein tiefgreifender oder vollschichtiger Knorpeldefekt. Intakter Innenmeniskus. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Trochlea:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Fokaler tiefgreifender Defekt an der medialen Patellafacette im mittleren Drittel (Serie 7/ Image 11) sowie an der lateralen Patellafacette im mittleren Drittel (Serie 7/ Image 12). Kein vollschichtiger Korpeldefekt. Kein subchondrales Ödem. Regelrechte Darstellung der Quadrizeps- und Patellarsehne. Regelrechte Darstellung des Hoffa`schen Fettkörpers.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und übrige Weichteile:
Akzentuierte Gelenkflüssigkeit.

There is a radial tear centred on the junction between the body and posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with an adjacent, more anteriorly located horizontal component extending into the body.
No accompanying displaced meniscal fragments, nor is there any significant medial meniscal body extrusion.
There is nonetheless an adjacent grade 1 superficial MCL sprain.

Intact lateral meniscus, cruciate and lateral collateral ligaments, popliteus musculotendinous unit, distal iliotibial band and the patellar tendon.

Chronic calcific distal insertional quadriceps tendinosis appreciated.

Small superolateral effusion, no intra-articular bodies demonstrated.

Focal high-grade medial retropatellar articular cartilage damage, well-maintained remaining tricompartmental hyaline articular cartilage surfaces - especially when considering the patient's age.

No skeletal abnormality of note.

Grossly unremarkable remaining imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

Antecedentes Clínicos:
Gonalgia derecha. Obs. Meniscopatía. Cuerpo libre.
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Meniscos impresionan de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura.
Úlceras condrales a parcial de la región central de la zona de carga del cóndilo femoral medial y
del platillo tibial lateral. No hay cambios óseos secundarios.
Úlceras condrales superficiales de distribución difusa de la rótula. Cartílago troclear sin
alteraciones significativas.
Aumento de señal del aspecto superoexterno de la grasa de Hoffa.
No hay derrame articular y quistes poplíteos.
Tendones cuadricipital, rotuliano, tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial
dentro de límites conservados.
Discreto edema de las partes blandas entre la banda iliotibial y el cóndilo femoral lateral.
Impresión:
Condropatía lesiones grado 2 de la región central del cóndilo femoral medial y del platillo tibial
lateral.
Condropatía superficial de la rótula.
Signos de un síndrome de hiperpresión externa de rótula.
Probables fenómenos de fricción de la banda de tibial

Exam Type: MRI KNEE RIGHT WO CONTRAST
Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Posterior knee pain at hamstring insertion. No injury or surgery.
Comparison: No relevant prior studies available for comparison.

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.2 Tesla open system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
No joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: Low grade partial thickness chondrosis lateral tibial plateau.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Full thickness fissure with cartilage flap formation lateral patellar facet.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle.

IMPRESSION:
Moderate patellar and mild lateral compartment chondrosis.

Mediales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Medialseitig etwas ausgedeünnter Knorpel femoral (Outerbrdige II). Intakter Innenmeniskus. Kleine parameniskale Zyste angrenzend an das Innenmeniskusvorderhorn (Serie 5/ Image 17). Intaktes MCL.

Laterales Kompartiment:
Regelrechtes Knochenmarksignal. Intakter Knorpel. Intakter Außenmeniskus. Intaktes LCL.

Femoropatellares Gleitlager und Patella:
An der lateralen Patellafacette kranial drittgradiger Knorpeldefekt nach Outerbridge (Serie 3/ Image 40). Ansonsten intakter Knorpel. Regelrechtes Lig. patellae.

Kreuzbänder:
Intakte Kreuzbänder.

Muskulatur und Weichteile:
Kein Gelenkerguss. Regelrechtes flow-void der erfassten Gefäße.
